sources.content:
WEBVTT

00:00.000 --> 00:04.000
create_app() constructs the FastAPI application and registers routes.

00:04.000 --> 00:08.000
GET /health reports service availability with status 200 OK.

00:08.000 --> 00:12.000
Run uvicorn app.main:app --reload during local development.

00:12.000 --> 00:16.000
@app.get declares an HTTP GET route returning items.

WEBVTT

00:00.000 --> 00:04.000
SQL SELECT queries read rows from PostgreSQL tables.

00:04.000 --> 00:08.000
Add tenant_id and project_id filters to isolate every SQL query.

00:08.000 --> 00:12.000
Commit a transaction only after all writes succeed; rollback on failure.

00:12.000 --> 00:16.000
Database migrations evolve schema without erasing existing rows.

WEBVTT

00:00.000 --> 00:04.000
Pydantic BaseModel validates request body fields.

00:04.000 --> 00:08.000
FastAPI returns status 422 when request body validation fails.

00:08.000 --> 00:12.000
pytest asserts HTTP status and response JSON in API tests.
